title: Hyper-Expansion trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.note: Decoded help topic for Hyper-Expansion; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #149 resource at file offset 0x2fa900, control 271, caption 'Hyper-Expansion'; style 0x50000009 (BS_AUTORADIOBUTTON)
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only Hyper-Expansion and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only Hyper-Expansion changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: Colonist growth rate is twice the value shown on wizard step 4 (documented-only).
Starts with one armed scout and three mini-colony ships (documented-only).
Exclusive Mini-Colonizer and Meta Morph hulls; Settler's Delight engine is limited to the Mini-Colonizer (documented-only).
Flux Capacitor increases beam-weapon damage on Hyper-Expansion ships by 20% (documented-only).
Cannot build stargates; maximum population is half the normal support value for the race environment (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact advantage-point cost is not stated by the help and was not recovered.
Whether the displayed growth rate is doubled before or after rounding is unknown.
The precise population-cap calculation and its interaction with other traits are unknown.
Runtime enforcement of the stargate prohibition and hull/engine restrictions is unverified.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
